get.summary: The caller's plan, usage and feature verdicts; loaded once per account by the console (PRD §10.21).
A job's state, polled by both apps (PRD §8.5). Public: its id is unguessable.
Bare. The caller's organizations with their members, newest first; an Admin sees every account's.

put.summary: Partial (at least one field). organization_users, when sent, is reconciled: by id, then email, then name + phone.

delete.summary: 204. Deletes the members too (D2). Counts one "organizations" (OrganizationDeleted).

404.description: FLOW_NOT_FOUND (also when the questionnaire is assigned and was looked up by slug or flow id)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Every word must appear in the title

200.description: The chain's prompts in order, with their text

get.summary: An ephemeral secret for one recording (~1 min, §13.4). P, rate limited.

502.description: INTERNAL_ERROR (the provider did not issue one)

post.summary:
A signed upload. answer_media (P): only for a session still being filled, of that account, with that question
(D4). prompt: the account's own users only (a chain prompt is written in the console).

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED (a prompt upload without a console user)

403.description: FORBIDDEN (a prompt upload for another account)

post.summary: A signed download of an answer's file, for the account it belongs to (the key's first segment).

put.summary: Saves progress. In a follow-up's shared session the members' answers merge (§7.11).

post.summary:
Submits the session and runs PRD §7.7. A quiz funnel answers 202 {job} (its result has the products); every
other type answers {type, …result, cta?, layout?, result_copy?}.

202.description: The job computing the result (quiz funnel)

get.summary: The results the respondent app shows at /session/{id}/results, with the flow's cta, layout and texts.
Every stage of the chain the respondent went through, for the account's answer detail.
